claim.label: incumbent process
claim.sentence: In-process inspection incumbent process An operator eyeballing parts against a boundary sample, plus a periodic trip to a CMM or gauge lab for dimensional checks on a sample.

value.text: An operator eyeballing parts against a boundary sample, plus a periodic trip to a CMM or gauge lab for dimensional checks on a sample.

assessment.author: editorial
assessment.rationale: Sampling means defects are found batches late, and human visual inspection degrades measurably across a shift — the two facts that fund every inspection automation project.
